footer.title: Kampot Seafood
footer.blurb: Fresh seafood every day at Samaki Market, Kampot. Order ahead, shop retail, or ask about supply for your restaurant.

home.hero_p1: We sell fresh seafood every day — order here. Pre-order for the next day to guarantee your catch.
home.hero_p2: Cooked seafood to order, fresh retail, and careful packing with experienced kitchen staff rooted in local flavors.
home.section_fresh_sub: Fresh seafood selection — see everything below.
home.b2b_p: For restaurant owners who need reliable, fresh seafood every day — we supply wholesale alongside our retail counter in Kampot.
home.location_en: Samaki Market, Kampot town center — same phone for pickup questions.
home.payments_p: We accept cash and common local payment methods at the stall.

checkout.privacy_notice: Your personal data will be used to process your order, support your experience throughout this website, and for other purposes described in our privacy policy.
checkout.refund_p1: Because our products are fresh seafood, quality depends on same-day handling and temperature. Please inspect your order at pickup or upon delivery.
checkout.refund_p2: Refunds or replacements are considered only for verified quality issues reported at the time of handover, in line with our stall policy and applicable law.
